chunks: We narrate to you from the history of Moses and Pharaoh in all verity, for those who believe.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the story of Moses and Pharaoh in the Quran for believers?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Hud emphasizes the divine authenticity of the narrative, presenting the conflict between Moses and Pharaoh not merely as history but as a theological lesson for the believers. In Shia scholarship, this account is often viewed as a paradigm of the struggle between truth (Haqq) and tyranny (Batil), reinforcing the concept of Imamate as the continuation of prophetic guidance against worldly powers.
